## History

Barry was a resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) whose property included a local landmark pond. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally caused his daughter [Diana](../character/diana.md) to fall ill, he was involved in the fallout when his wife temporarily banned [Anne](../character/anne.md) from seeing [Diana](../character/diana.md). He later had his home host a party where [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dared [Anne](../character/anne.md) to walk the ridgepole of his roof; when [Anne](../character/anne.md) fell and broke her ankle, Mr. Barry carried her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
